info.name: Restful Booker API
info.description:
Postman collection mirroring all 36 Playwright API automation tests for Restful Booker (https://restful-booker.herokuapp.com).

**Run Playwright tests:**
- `npm test` — full suite (36 tests)
- `npm run test:ping` — health check
- `npm run test:auth` — auth tests
- `npm run test:booking` — booking tests
- `npm run test:report` — run with HTML report
- `npm run typecheck` — TypeScript validation

**Variables:** Set `baseUrl`, `username`, `password`. Pre-request scripts create `token` and `bookingId` when needed.
